metadata.title: AI Agent Knowledge Base: Animation, AI & Productivity Tools
metadata.description: Curated database of high-performance animation libraries, AI UI generators, debugging tools, and accessibility standards optimized for AI agent context retrieval and creative tech workflows.

tools.name: GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform)
tools.description: A high-performance, framework-agnostic JavaScript library for professional-grade web animations. Enables complex sequences via Timelines, staggers, and physics-based effects across CSS, SVG, Canvas, and Three.js. Includes a specialized useGSAP hook for React.
tools.ai_agent_context: Use for complex, timeline-based animations across DOM, SVG, and Canvas. Ideal when React-specific libraries are insufficient or when framework independence is required.
tools.performance_considerations: GPU-accelerated by default. Avoid animating layout properties (width, top, left) to prevent thrashing.
tools.accessibility_rules: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Provide pause/stop controls for sequences >5s.

tools.name: GSAP ScrollTrigger
tools.description: A powerful GSAP plugin that binds animations to scroll position. Features include scrubbing, pinning elements, viewport awareness, and horizontal scroll creation.
tools.ai_agent_context: Use for scroll-driven storytelling, pinned sections, or horizontal scroll galleries. Integrates seamlessly with core GSAP timelines.
tools.performance_considerations: Use markers: false in production. Debounce scroll listeners if not using native ScrollTrigger.
tools.accessibility_rules: Ensure pinned content does not trap keyboard focus. Provide skip links for long scroll sections.

tools.name: Motion (formerly Framer Motion)
tools.description: A modern, MIT-licensed animation library for React and Vue known for declarative syntax and gesture-based interactions. Features built-in layout animations, hardware-accelerated spring physics, and a modular architecture for small bundle sizes.
tools.ai_agent_context: Preferred choice for React/Vue component-level animations, micro-interactions, and layout transitions. Excellent for gesture-driven UI.
tools.performance_considerations: Use `layoutId` for shared element transitions. Animate only `transform` and `opacity`.

tools.name: v0.dev
tools.description: Vercel's generative AI tool that creates high-fidelity React/Tailwind CSS components (Shadcn/UI) from text prompts or images. Acts as an AI pair programmer for rapid prototyping.
tools.ai_agent_context: Use for rapid UI scaffolding, component iteration, or converting Figma screenshots into production-ready React code.
tools.performance_considerations: Generated code may include redundant Tailwind classes. Run through linter/tree-shaker before commit.
tools.accessibility_rules: Verify ARIA labels and semantic HTML in generated output. AI defaults may lack explicit focus management.

tools.name: Microsoft Edge 3D View
tools.description: A productivity tool within Edge DevTools to visualize web pages in a 3D scene. Helps debug DOM complexity, z-index stacking contexts, and compositing layers processed by the GPU.
tools.ai_agent_context: Use to diagnose z-index conflicts, modal stacking issues, or identify unnecessary compositing layers causing repaint bottlenecks.
tools.performance_considerations: Reduces `will-change` overuse by visualizing actual GPU-composited layers.

tools.name: Animation Inspector (Chrome/Firefox)
tools.description: Built-in browser tools for inspecting, modifying, and slowing down CSS animations and transitions in real-time. Provides a timeline scrubber and Bezier Curve Editor.
tools.ai_agent_context: Use to fine-tune `cubic-bezier` curves, debug `@keyframes` timing, and slow down complex CSS transitions for visual QA.
tools.performance_considerations: Identifies forced synchronous layouts caused by inline animation JS.
tools.accessibility_rules: Helps verify animation duration aligns with WCAG 2.2 (pause/stop >5s).

tools.name: Motion Studio
tools.description: An IDE extension for VS Code and Cursor that provides visual animation editing tools. Features include CSS spring generation using the linear() function and performance auditing for Motion/CSS animations.
tools.ai_agent_context: Use inside Cursor/VSCode to visually tweak spring physics, generate optimized `linear()` easing, and audit animation bundle impact.
tools.performance_considerations: Optimizes `linear()` curves to reduce main-thread calculation overhead.
tools.accessibility_rules: Includes built-in motion preference toggles for testing.

tools.name: Hope AI (Bit.cloud)
tools.description: An AI agent that generates production-grade design systems from a single prompt. Creates reusable components, unit tests, and documentation, utilizing Ripple CI for automated validation.
tools.ai_agent_context: Use to scaffold enterprise-grade component libraries with auto-generated tests, docs, and versioning.
tools.performance_considerations: Components are tree-shakable and published as optimized npm packages.
tools.accessibility_rules: Enforces a11y checks via Ripple CI pipeline before publish.

tools.name: WCAG 2.2 Checklist (WebAIM)
tools.description: Guidance on web accessibility standards focusing on animation rules (Pause, Stop, Hide). Recommends respecting prefers-reduced-motion to prevent motion sickness and ensure compliance.
tools.ai_agent_context: Use as a validation checklist for all AI-generated UI/animation code. Enforces legal and ethical accessibility compliance.
tools.accessibility_rules: Mandatory: `prefers-reduced-motion` media query, no flashing >3Hz, pause/stop for auto-play >5s.

tools.name: Three.js
tools.description: An open-source JavaScript library used to create and render interactive 3D graphics in the browser using WebGL. Abstracts low-level complexity for 3D objects, lighting, and particle systems.
tools.ai_agent_context: Use for immersive 3D experiences, product configurators, or WebGL shaders. Pair with GSAP for timeline control.
tools.performance_considerations: Optimize geometry, use instanced meshes, and limit draw calls. Avoid heavy post-processing on mobile.
tools.accessibility_rules: Provide 2D fallbacks. Ensure keyboard/navigation parity for 3D scenes.

tools.name: Wappalyzer
tools.description: A technology profiler extension that identifies the software stack used on a website. Detects programming languages, CMS, frameworks, and JavaScript libraries.
tools.ai_agent_context: Use for competitive tech-stack analysis, client discovery, or identifying animation libraries used by industry leaders.
